description: Macroeconomic indicators per country from World Bank Open Data with yearly history: inflation, GDP, GDP growth, GDP per capita, unemployment, population, government debt, current account, exports, lending rate. Optionally current ECB policy rates. Params: country (ISO2 or ISO3, required), indicators (default inflation, gdp, gdp_growth, unemployment, population), years (1 to 20, default 5), include_ecb_rates (default false). Price: $0.003 USDC per call, paid inside this MCP call via x402 (USDC on Base or Solana). x402 MCP clients such as @x402/mcp pay automatically. Free sample: call with the example input {"country":"DE","indicators":["inflation","unemployment","gdp_growth"],"years":3}.
name: macro_data
title: Macroeconomic Data
